terms.comment: Pliny’s blotting paper (charta bibula, Ep. 8.15.2), here for the paper that drains fried food.

phrases.latin: chartā bibulā siccātōs calidōs aut tepidōs appōnitō
phrases.english: drain them on kitchen paper and serve them hot or warm

sources: Theodōrus et pater: Culīna Theodōrī, the recipe book that goes with the libellī (Ad Libellōs I–VII); examples marked “Culīna Theodōrī” quote it word for word.
